THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
RUNWAY
080
STUDY 090
Open-Knit Cream Sweater & Suede Shorts
Rights check
Source: 24972.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy black hair
walks a runway in a cream open-knit sweater with
distressed, frayed sleeves and hem. She wears dark
brown suede shorts with a wide tan leather belt, white
lace socks, and tall tan suede knee-high boots with
lace-up ties. She carries a large dark brown leather
tote. Her expression is calm and direct. A pale gray
backdrop with a warm brown floor. Palette of cream,
chocolate, and tan. Relaxed and textured, in the style of
an autumn runway editorial.
Relaxed, textured, editorial
WORKING NOTES
- The frayed knit and lace socks define the texture.
- Add 'mid-stride' for the walking motion.
